title: Stone tools (synthetic example)
scope_note: A made-up pack to show the format and to test that telling founders a practice changes what a village does. It is not drawn from any real culture or text.

sources.citation: Written for the Little Chits lab as an example; describes the game's own recipes

claims.text: Two stones struck together give an edge that cuts.
An edge bound to a stick fells trees faster than bare hands.
A tool that works should be shown to the others.

reviewer_notes: Synthetic; nothing to review for accuracy. Real packs (research plan R15) need sourced claims and a named reviewer.
